previous_statement: Using the local partition from 1.4.3.3.1, a_j^+>=0 and H_j>=0 give sum_{j notin G}a_j^+H_j=sum_{j in B}a_j^+H_j+sum_{j in Z}a_j^+H_j. The Z term is zero because H_j=0 on Z, and on B each H_j<=tau/4, so the B term is at most (tau/4) sum_{j in B}a_j^+. Substituting sum_{j in B}a_j^+=sigma-sigma_g from 1.4.3.3.1 yields sum_{j notin G}a_j^+H_j <= (sigma-sigma_g)*tau/4.
new_statement: With H_j=dist_1(p_j,C), G={j:H_j>tau/4}, B={j:0<H_j<=tau/4}, and Z={j:H_j=0}, nonnegativity of distances gives the disjoint partition {j:notin G}=B union Z. By def-invisible-mass, sigma is the sum of a_j^+ over rows with H_j>0, and by the contract sigma_g is the sum of a_j^+ over rows with H_j>tau/4, so sigma-sigma_g=sum_{j in B}a_j^+. Also H_j=0 on Z and H_j<=tau/4 on B. Since a_j^+>=0, sum_{j notin G}a_j^+H_j=sum_{j in B}a_j^+H_j+sum_{j in Z}a_j^+H_j <= (tau/4)*sum_{j in B}a_j^+=(sigma-sigma_g)*tau/4.
